release_notes: Skill 2.7.2. Temperature drops from 0.2 to 0.0 for delegation (routing gate G3): two models cannot be compared on one prompt while either is still sampling, so figures taken at 0.2 mixed signal with noise. Ground chat stays at 0.2 on purpose. c2g_check.py now ships with the skill and is step 1 of the verification sequence, ahead of reading the reply -- exit 1 is a hard fail, exit 2 means the check could not run and proves nothing, and a repair the checker works out is reported as a WARN rather than applied silently. Its documented location was previously wrong for the one case that needs it: the text pointed at ~/.claude/skills/, which does not exist in a cloud session. bridge_delegate now locates the bridge relative to its own path before falling back to the sandbox mount and the bare-host default, so a cloud session no longer has to be told C2G_BRIDGE, and NO-BRIDGE names all four routes it tried. Also folds in 2.7.1: the LaunchAgent label is com.cloud2ground.watcher (Step 1 named a label that does not exist), WATCHER-DOWN means nothing is in flight rather than that the watcher is down, and the run-to-completion / no-overlap assumptions are now written down -- never kill a poll mid-run, never abandon a request. The footer no longer carries a version number; the frontmatter version: is the only one.
pro_notes: Skill 3.0.1 adds guidance for when the bridge folder is not connected to the session: it tells a disconnected folder from a stopped watcher, asks you once to add the folder, and stops cleanly if access is refused. The NO-BRIDGE message now says what to do. 3.0.0 added the bridge usability check: the folder is tested for read, traverse and write access rather than mere existence, with exit code 9 (BRIDGE-UNUSABLE) and a non-fatal BRIDGE-WARN for sync-conflict duplicates.
_doc: Skill update manifest. Consumed by the C2G Mac app's SkillUpdateManager, which fetches https://carlanotech.github.io/carlano-site/skill/manifest.json. The payload_url is a fully-qualified URL to a zip containing the skill files at the archive root (SKILL.md at top level); the installer also accepts one level of wrapping folder.
_payload_sha256_note: This is the authoritative standalone manifest: payload_sha256 is the SHA-256 of skill-2.7.2.zip as published. The copy inside that zip keeps the field null, since it cannot reference the archive containing it.
_free_line_note: 2026-11-21: `version` and `payload_url` describe the FREE line and MUST NOT be bumped, ever. 2.7.2 is the LAST free skill release — there will be no 2.7.3, no 2.8. Two independent reasons, either one sufficient: (1) builds shipped before 2026-11-21 require payload_url to decode this file and will DOWNLOAD AND INSTALL whatever it points at, so anything newer advertised here is given away to every existing install; (2) from 3.0.0 the skill is a paid product. The free line is 2.7.2, it is what the app bundles and what the Claude Code plugin ships, and it stays Apache-2.0 permanently. If you are here to publish a skill update, it does not belong in this file.
_pro_line_note: The pro_* keys advertise the PAID line, sold on agensi.io. Builds before 2026-11-21 ignore unknown keys, so these are invisible to them. Builds from 2026-11-21 compare pro_version against the installed skill and, if newer, show a menu-bar dot and a link to pro_store_url. The app never downloads a paid skill: delivery happens in the buyer's Agensi account.
_pro_store_url_note: 2026-11-23: resolved. pro_store_url is the live Agensi listing for the skill itself, not the creator profile (https://www.agensi.io/creators/carlano-technology-solutions), so a buyer lands on the thing rather than on a list. Verified HTTP 200 the day it went in. SkillUpdateManager.fallbackStoreURL deliberately stays the product page, which links onward to the store, so a missing or unparseable value here degrades to a working page rather than a dead button — do not point the fallback at Agensi too, or a typo in this file has nowhere safe to land.
_location_note: 2026-11-22: this manifest and its payload moved to the carlano-site repo (the website), published at https://carlanotech.github.io/carlano-site/skill/. They were previously addressed at raw.githubusercontent.com/carlanotech/Cloud2GroundAI/main/skill/, which returned 404 for every path in that repo including README.md and LICENSE, so the update check never once worked in a shipped build. It failed safe, which is why nobody noticed. That repo was also the wrong home by policy: RELEASE_PROCESS.md limits it to the DMG, its checksum, README, LICENSE and NOTICE. The website is already public, already serves the DMG, and publishing to it is an ordinary site deploy. Builds v2.6 and earlier still point at the dead URL and cannot be redirected; they fail safe and the skill they bundle is unaffected.
_payload_url_note: payload_url and payload_sha256 are now effectively vestigial, and deliberately kept correct rather than removed. Only builds from 2026-11-22 can reach this file, and those builds never download a payload. The builds that WOULD have downloaded it (v2.6 and earlier) are pinned to the dead raw URL and can never see this file at all. The zip is published beside this manifest anyway so that nothing in a published document is a 404, and so a future build could install the free line from the network if that is ever wanted.
